Liveness checks if process healthy; readiness checks if it can receive traffic. Avoid exposing internal
diagnostics publicly.
Liveness check එක process එක alive දෙ බලෙනවා. Readiness check එක traffic handle කරන්න සූදොනම්දෙ
Deployment removes an unready server from traffic.
Read the diagram: A live process might still be unready to serve requests.
Expected result: If readiness dependencies fail, readiness returns 503.

Interview question: Why separate liveness and readiness?
Answer: Avoid routing traffic to an unavailable instance without necessarily restarting it.
Practice: Choose which dependency failures should affect readiness.
